review_scope: Every exact full-frame image-bank photograph and every purpose-made picture-book panel used by the assembled lesson.

checks: the intended object kind is unmistakable at lesson scale
no selected image requires a focus crop
contextual transfer images preserve the target as the dominant readable object
plate/bowl and cup/bowl boundaries are safe for a zero-grounding learner
rejections: registry Plate asset 15650 is actually a sink
registry Bowl asset 3987 resembles a wastebasket
registry Bowl asset 4041 is an unsafe shallow-dish boundary case
registry Coffee cup assets 87 and 15091 hide the handle and can read as bowls

checks: the same blue cup, yellow plate, silver spoon, and green bowl persist across all panels
each movement panel retains all prior placed objects and all not-yet-moved objects
the initial and terminal states contain no hand
no panel contains text, extra tableware, food, a face, or a recurring character
each extracted page follows an intentional panel border and preserves the whole scene

crop_decision: No image-bank crop is necessary. The six picture-book page files are intentional panel extractions from a purpose-made storyboard, not focus crops.
